newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's upper Senate passed the bill on the status of education staff.
* The members of the centrist ruling coalition met President Emil Constantinescu late on Monday.
Ion Diaconescu, head of the Democratic Convention, said the talks with the Constantinescu focused on legislation priorities and on the situation of banking system.

* Emil Cioflan, president of troubled Romanian private bank Credit Bank, which was stripped of its banking licence, slams the central bank's move saying that would ask a parliamentary comission to check BNR decision. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
